## The claim

P4-16: Boltz-2 folds wild-type and mutant BubR1 with a visible local confidence change at the confirmed missense residue

**Prediction if true.** mean pLDDT within 5 residues of the substituted residue drops by 5 points or more in the mutant fold versus wild type

**What would refute it.** the local pLDDT change is under 1 point in absolute value (the fold cannot see the substitution)
